summary: Compiled TikZ reconstruction of the semicircle figure (version 3, best critic score 0.92, must_repair=false). Contents: upper semicircle arc from M through P to N (centre O, radius ~237 px), diameter MN, segment OP, point A on OP, point B on the arc, segments AB and OB, with filled dots at O, A, B and labels M, N, O, P, A, B. Labels and vertices were bound by CV (Hungarian, NCC 0.85–0.95) and confirmed by critic label check. No right angles claimed (none verified).

Reconstructed the figure as a trapezoid ABCD (AB parallel to DC) in TikZ. Vertex labels A, B, C, D were bound by template matching (NCC > 0.84). The figure compiled, and the critic scored it 0.92 with must_repair=false and all labels present. No circles or right-angle marks were verified, so none were drawn.

Reconstructed the figure as a compiled TikZ trapezoid ABCD (version 1). Vertices A, D (top) and B, C (bottom) were bound by CV label matching with NCC 0.84-0.90 and no ambiguous matches. The critic scored it 0.88 with no high or medium issues and must_repair=false. Its only note was that the edge strokes are heavier than the original, a low-severity style point that I did not repair.

Reconstructed trapezoid ABCD (top AD, bottom BC, legs AB and DC, both diagonals crossing at an unlabeled interior point) as compilable TikZ. Version 3 compiles and has critic score 0.9. Geometry and labels A, B, C, D match the original.

Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (v1): quadrilateral-style figure with vertices A (top-left), D (top-right), C (bottom-right), B (bottom-left), edges AD, BC, AB, CD and diagonal BD, labels A–D placed at vertices. Critic score 0.92, must_repair false, all labels present. Only remaining note: edge stroke is slightly thinner than the original (low severity, not repaired).

Reconstructed the figure as a compiled TikZ quadrilateral ABCD (A top-left, D top, C bottom-right, B bottom-left, with diagonal DC) using CV line detection and Hungarian-bound labels A, B, C, D. Critic score 0.95, must_repair false, all four labels present. Only a low-severity note about stroke weight remains (optional).

Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (version 2, critic-reviewed, must_repair=false, score 0.93). It contains vertices A, B, C, D, E, F, G with solid edges A-D, D-C, C-B, A-E, F-E, A-F, dashed A-B, B-E, and dashed F-G extension to G on base BC.

Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 3, best and critic-clean). It shows a full circle centred at O with radius 236 px, a vertical diameter AB, solid chords AE, AF and EF, and dashed radii OE and OF. Labels A, B, D, E, F and O are present, and a filled centre dot is drawn at O. The critic scored v3 at 0.93 with no issues and checklist score 1.0.

Compiled TikZ (v1) reconstructing the figure: big circle centred at O with radius ~236 px, small circle centred at B with radius ~94.5 px, solid diameter AB, solid line F–O–E, dashed chords E–B and C–B, and labels A–F plus O. The critic scored it 0.9 with no must-repair issues; the only remaining note is a low-severity offset of the label E, which is cosmetic.

Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (version 3, critic score 0.86, must_repair=false, checklist 1.0). It shows the big circle through A, B, C with center O, the chords AC, AB and CB, the small tangent circle centered at P with tangency point M, and dashed OC, OB and O-P-M lines. Labels A, B, C, O, P and M are all present.

Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction of 1467_q_fig5.png (version 2, best_version=2). Critic score 0.92, checklist 1.0, must_repair=false, no actionable issues. Labels A, B, C, D, E, N present; dashed CN with right-angle mark at N; overhangs past C removed in v2.

Reconstructed quadrilateral ABCD as standalone TikZ (version 1, compiled and validated). Vertices come from bind_point_labels (A, B, C, D), with solid edges AB, BC, CD, DA and no dashed segments. Right-angle marks at C and A were verified by detect_right_angle_marker and are drawn in the TikZ. The critic scored it 0.93 with checklist 1.0, must_repair false, and all four labels present.

Reconstructed the figure as compilable standalone TikZ (version 2, best_version=2). The critic scored it 0.93 with checklist_score 1.0 and must_repair=false. The figure is square ABCD with solid sides, solid spokes from B to D, E (on top edge AD) and F (on right edge DC), and a dashed E–F line crossing the diagonal DB at an unlabeled intersection point. Labels A–F are all present. The scale and origin were chosen by the TikZ agent (s≈0.021164 cm/px, origin at B).

Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 3, best). It shows triangle ABC with solid sides, the inscribed solid square DEFG with D and E on AB and AC, solid segment BG, and dashed altitude AH to H on BC. All eight labels A–H are present. The critic scored v3 at 0.95 with must_repair=false. The F label was moved beside its vertex as the critic requested.

Reconstructed the figure as a right triangle ABC with the right angle at C (verified square mark), labels A, B, C bound by CV and matching the visible letters. Final version v2 compiled and critic-reviewed: score 0.93, must_repair false, no open issues. No circles detected in the figure.

Reconstructed the figure as a compilable TikZ triangle ABC with altitude AD (solid), a verified right-angle mark at foot D, and labels A, B, C, D. Version 1 compiled and passed validation; critic score 0.93, checklist 1.0, no actionable issues, labels present (A, B, C, D).

Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 2, best version). No right-angle marks were drawn because detect_right_angle_marker verified none. The critic scored v2 at 0.93 with checklist 1.0 and no remaining actionable issues.

Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 2, critic score 0.92, must_repair=false). It contains the points A, B, C, D, E, H with segments B–A, B–C (through D), A–D, D–E, and the vertical A–E (through C), a dashed altitude A–H, and right-angle marks at H and D. The labels were verified visually. Vertex dots were removed as requested.

Produced compiled TikZ v1 for the figure: triangle-like configuration with vertices A (top), E (bottom), D (left), C (on AE), M (foot on AD) with solid AD, AE, DE, DC, dashed MC, and right-angle marks at M and D. Critic score 0.93, must_repair=false, all five labels present.

Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 1). Labels A, B, C, D were bound via template matching (NCC 0.84–0.90). The figure is a triangle with cevian AB on base DC and a right-angle mark at C. Critic score 0.92, must_repair=false; the only open item is a cosmetic note that the labels are slightly smaller and lighter than the original.

Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ (version 1, compiled and validated). Labels B, A, C, E, G, D were bound and confirmed visually. No right-angle marks were verified, so none were drawn.

Produced a compilable TikZ reconstruction (v1) of the 490x340 figure: parallelogram ADCB with E on AD, F and N on AB, G on EB, solid/dashed construction lines (EC, DB, EN, NG dashed; EF, EGB, GC solid), labels A–G and N. Critic scored 0.9 with no actionable issues; all 8 labels present.

Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (version 1, best version). The figure is rectangle ABCD with M on AD, E and N on BC, F on DC, and segments AE, MN (parallel to AE), BF through O, and NF. A right-angle mark is drawn at the foot of AE on BF. The critic scored it 0.92, all nine labels (A, B, C, D, E, F, M, N, O) are present, and must_repair is false.

Reconstructed the figure as compilable TikZ. Best version is v3 (critic score 0.95). Versions v2–v4 each added or re-anchored the K mark; v4 compiles but has not been scored because the critic returned a cached verdict.

Compiled TikZ figure (version 2, critic score 0.88, must_repair=false). Its only note is that the point labels render slightly smaller and lighter than the original, a low-severity item I did not repair.

Compiled TikZ (v1) reconstructs the figure: triangle-like configuration with vertices B, C (base), A, E (top corners), and D at the intersection of BA and EC. Segments BC, BE, EC, BA, AC are solid. Produced a compiled TikZ reconstruction (v1) of the figure: triangle ABD, altitude BH with H on AD, segments AE and ED, E on BH and on a full circle centered at D through E, with labels A, B, D, E, H. Critic score 0.92, must_repair false, all five labels present, checklist 1.0.

Compiled TikZ (v1) reconstructs the figure: rectangle ABCD (D top-left, C top-right, B bottom-right, A bottom-left), diagonal AC, and segment AE with E on top edge DC near its midpoint, labels A–E. No right-angle marks (verified absent) and no arc (circle candidate rejected by geometry agent after image check). Critic score 0.93, checklist 1.0, must_repair false.

Reconstructed the figure as a compiling standalone TikZ file: triangle ABC with interior point D on BC and cevian AD, solid lines, labels A, B, C, D, and filled vertex dots. Produced compilable TikZ (v2, best version) reconstructing the figure: full circle centred at D with radius 236 px, chord AC, segments AB, CD (through B), AD and the vertical DE with E as the midpoint of AC. Reconstructed the figure as a TikZ triangle ABC with cevian AD to base point D on BC, labels A, B, C, D. Compiled on the first attempt; critic score 0.94 with no actionable issues (only overall scale differs).

Reconstructed the figure as a compiled TikZ parallelogram ABCD. Four vertices come from bound point labels (A top-right, B right-middle, C bottom-left, D left-middle). Its only issue was that the BD stroke looked thinner. v2 removed the per-segment width override, and the source now matches the other sides, but the critic still reports it thin. v2 has not been re-scored, so best_version still points to v1.

restore_note: best.* recompiled from the first rerun's stored TeX; later reruns were superseded. Original A-E-C has a genuine bend at E, so the critic's straight-line arc_error is a false positive.
